title: Permutations (order matters)
quickIdea: Arrangements where position matters. If objects repeat, divide by the factorial of each repeat count.
remember: n distinct objects in n places: n!.
Choose and arrange r of n: P(n,r) = n!/(n-r)!.
n objects around a circle: (n-1)! (rotations are the same seating).
With repeats n1, n2, ...: n! / (n1! n2! ...).
gateAngle: Order questions usually hide inside strings. The gap template - arrange the fixed symbols, then choose gaps for the others - turns a hard arrangement into one binomial (GATE 1999 Q.1.3).

variations.label: ORIGINAL PYQ-STYLE QUESTION
variations.question: In how many ways can 5 people sit at a round table if two particular people refuse to sit together?
variations.why: Total circular seatings: (5-1)! = 24. Seatings with the pair together: glue them into one block, giving (4-1)! = 6 orders of the four units, times 2 internal orders of the pair = 12. Subtract: 24 - 12 = 12.

trap.what: Treating reflections like rotations in a circular arrangement.
trap.why: A round table identifies rotations only. A necklace or bracelet also identifies reflections, which halves the count again.
trap.counterexample: 4 people at a round table: (4-1)! = 6. As a bracelet it is 6/2 = 3, because mirror images are then the same object.

check.question: How many distinct arrangements of the letters of LEVEL are there?
check.explanation: 5 letters with L twice and E twice: 5!/(2!2!) = 120/4 = 30.
